title: Recipe Card: Lists in Action
prompt:
Build the content section of a recipe page.

Requirements:
- An `<h2>` with the recipe name.
- An *unordered* list with the ingredients (at least 3 `<li>`).
- An *ordered* list with the steps (at least 3 `<li>`).
- The right list type for each — the tests check which one you used.

tests.name: has a heading
tests.hint: Sub-headings use <h2>; write a real recipe name between the tags.

tests.name: unordered list with at least 3 ingredients
tests.hint:
Ingredients have no order, so wrap them in
    …
with one
  • each.

tests.name: ordered list with at least 3 steps
tests.hint:
Steps happen in sequence, so use
    …
— the browser numbers them.

tests.name: did not use ol for ingredients
tests.hint: Choosing <ul> vs <ol> is a meaning decision: shuffled order must not change the meaning of ingredients.
